name: Ramada by Wyndham Hamilton City Center
description: Only a 5-minute drive to Claudelands Events Centre and within walking distance of many restaurants, pubs, cafes and shops, this hotel is housed in an iconic 1876 historic building, offering 69 well-appointed rooms with a variety of room types and configurations. The hotel features on-site parking, wireless internet access, ensuite, kitchenettes in the 2 BDR apartments, laundry facilities and 24-hour guest services.
address: 287 Victoria Street Hamilton Central, Hamilton 3204 New Zealand
